senses.gloss: (preced. wds.) to be bare.—Hithpa. הִתְיַיחֵף, Nithpa. נִתְיַי׳ to be exposed, to take cold. Lam. R. introd. (R. Joh. 2) כדי שלא יִתְיַיחֲפוּ רגליהם that their feet might not be exposed (that they might not take cold); אע״פ כן נִתְיַיחֲפוּ וכ׳ and yet they did take cold. Ib. to I, 16.
